name: Self-advancing goals
principle: Goals keep moving between a person's sessions, because the work they delegated gets done to the standard they wrote.
state_description: You schedule an AI task the way you schedule a goal, and at that time it happens: grounded, finished to its written standard, reported against the goal, with your attention asked for only where it is needed.
hints_of_measurement: Delegated tasks finish to their written standard without rework.

name: Personally grounded help
principle: Every answer and action rests on the person's own goals, material and preferences, and never on another person's.
state_description: Asking Quest AI feels like asking a colleague who has read everything relevant to you, says only what your material supports, and never mentions anyone else's.
hints_of_measurement: Replies state the facts the account holds, state nothing it does not, and nothing crosses scope.

name: Trusted autonomy
principle: The AI acts first on what it may decide and brings the person exactly the decisions that are theirs.
state_description: Work moves without you, and when a question reaches you it is one only you should answer, with what you need to answer it.
hints_of_measurement: No human-only step is taken alone, and few asks turn out to be unnecessary.

name: One shared engine
principle: One domain-free engine serves every consumer, every lane and both chat and scheduled work, and differs only in configuration.
state_description: A new product or team gets grounded, escalating AI help by supplying configuration and adapters, and every improvement reaches everyone who uses it.
hints_of_measurement: Consumers add little glue of their own and copy none of the engine.

name: Metric-led evolution
principle: Every part of QAR improves as the state of the art moves, with the best implementation chosen by its metric.
state_description: When a better model, method or tool appears, it is measured against the current one on the same cases and becomes the default if it wins, without a rewrite.
hints_of_measurement: Every part has a current measured result, and selections follow the measurements.

name: Visible value
principle: What AI work costs and how good it is are known before they surprise anyone.
state_description: Operators see cost per result and quality per part as they go, budgets hold, and a drop in quality shows up in a metric before it shows up in a complaint.
hints_of_measurement: Every run reports its cost, and every part has a quality metric with a recent result.

name: Proportionate Routing
principle: Each message gets the cheapest handling that still gets the right outcome.
state_description: A question gets an answer, a change request gets the change, a big job gets autonomous work, and a destructive ask gets a question first, all without the person choosing a mode or paying for more machinery than the message needed.
hints_of_measurement: Compare, on the same labelled messages, the share routed correctly and the spend per message; a deep run for a plain question counts against it.

name: Grounded Reply
principle: A reply says only what the person's own account and its sources support, and says what it found.
state_description: Every fact in an answer can be traced to the account, every link is real, and when the AI does not know it says so instead of filling the gap.
hints_of_measurement: Named facts held in the account appear in the reply; unsupported claims and unverified links are flagged by a check or a human reading the sources.

name: Exact Change
principle: The final state matches the request: everything asked, nothing else, once.
state_description: After the AI acts, the quest differs from before in exactly the way the person described, and a retry or a repeat leaves it unchanged.
hints_of_measurement: Compare the data before and after a scripted request with the expected diff; any extra write or missing step is a miss.

name: Lasting Correction
principle: A correction given once is kept as said and applied wherever it bears.
state_description: The person never has to repeat a standing preference, and a one-time request does not become a permanent rule.
hints_of_measurement: Replay a stored correction against later turns and check it is shown when relevant and not otherwise.

name: Unbroken Thread
principle: A conversation carries what the person just said, wherever in time it appears.
state_description: A follow-up is understood without restating, a message sent during a run is taken into account, and nothing from another conversation intrudes.
hints_of_measurement: A follow-up that shares no words with its referent still finds it; a mid-run message reaches the next decision exactly once.

name: Bounded Prompt
principle: Every prompt stays within a budget derived from the model window and the cost per call, with nothing repeated.
state_description: No call fails for being too long, no block appears twice, and the most relevant material survives when something must give.
hints_of_measurement: Measured size at each assembly point against its budget, and a count of duplicated blocks.

name: Current Knowledge
principle: What the AI reads still matches the source it came from, and outages are loud but harmless.
state_description: A changed or deleted source is noticed, a pointer resolves to its current text, and an unreachable backend degrades to the last known state without losing writes.
hints_of_measurement: Every changed or deleted source is flagged and no unchanged one is; after an outage no write is missing.

name: Findable Knowledge
principle: The knowledge that bears on a question is found whatever words it uses.
state_description: A question phrased unlike its answer still brings the answer to the top of the evidence, at a cost that fits the turn.
hints_of_measurement: Rank of the known-relevant card for questions phrased differently, against the tokens and latency spent.

name: Safe Search
principle: Web answers come from the right passage, fetched safely and paid for once.
state_description: No fetch reaches an address it should not, a repeated query is not paid for twice, and the passage returned answers the query.
hints_of_measurement: Blocked-address cases are all refused; the right passage is returned for sampled queries at the lowest spend.

name: Accountable Autonomy
principle: Autonomous work runs to a written goal, within bounds, and stops exactly when it should.
state_description: A run that is idle, blocked on a person, at a limit or looping is stopped, a slow run that is progressing is left alone, and every outcome is reported the same way.
hints_of_measurement: False stops and missed stops over labelled run logs; goal met within the budget on the runner that fits the job.

name: Verified Completion
principle: A report of done is true.
state_description: When the AI says it is finished, the goal can be seen to be met in real state, and unexecuted work is never described as done.
hints_of_measurement: A reply claiming completion is checked against the final state; mismatches are counted.

name: Legible Progress
principle: The person sees what they need and no more, for the mode they are in.
state_description: A live viewer sees every step, a background viewer sees milestones and requests for them, and nothing important is buried.
hints_of_measurement: For each mode, the set of events shown against the set that mode defines.

name: Informed Consent
principle: A human-only step reaches a person with enough detail to decide, and the AI stops until they do.
state_description: Every confirmation arrives, once, with what is about to happen and why, and nothing irreversible runs before the answer.
hints_of_measurement: Each confirm is delivered with its required details; no irreversible action precedes it.

name: Predictable Spend
principle: Cost is known before it is spent and bounded while it is spent.
state_description: An operator can say what a run will cost, a daily budget stops work, and an overloaded host pauses pickup without flapping.
hints_of_measurement: Estimated against recorded cost per run; budget stop and resume behaviour on scripted days.

name: Right-Sized Model
principle: The cheapest model that can do the task does it, and waiting beats failing.
state_description: Easy turns use small models, hard ones start higher, an exhausted tier falls to the next, and an outage waits.
hints_of_measurement: Pass rate and cost per tier on the same cases; the chosen tier against the cheapest passing tier.

name: Clean Publication
principle: Nothing secret or consumer specific is ever published.
state_description: A planted secret of any known kind is found before commit, a documented placeholder is not flagged, and the repository scans clean.
hints_of_measurement: Planted secrets caught and placeholders passed on fixtures; the tree itself scans clean.

name: Trustworthy Interface
principle: What the documents say is true of the code, and a newcomer can start from them.
state_description: Every documented name imports, every example runs offline, every setting is described, every link works, and a bad setting fails at startup.
hints_of_measurement: Generated checks over names, examples, links, environment variables and subcommands all pass on an empty environment.

name: Dependable Delivery
principle: What is handed to the system arrives once, in order, and is accounted for.
state_description: A queued task is claimed once and ends reported as done, failed or needing a person; a channel message is delivered once and in order.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted queues and channels show no loss, no duplicate, no early or misrouted run.

name: Permitted Timing
principle: Background work happens exactly when the person's settings allow and never otherwise.
state_description: A quest is worked when budget, cadence, a run-now request, a trigger and the roster all allow it, and not on any day or past any budget the person set.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted settings and clocks give the expected run or no-run decision for every combination.

name: Remembered Work
principle: Work already worked out once is not worked out again, and what was learned is kept.
state_description: A recurring ask is answered by the known recipe at a fraction of the cost with the same result, a lookalike never triggers a write, and learned patterns survive restart per scope.
hints_of_measurement: Replay result against the slow path result, with model calls and cost; saved patterns reload after a restart.

name: Structured Habit
principle: An AI that works here names the problem, the ideal and the metric, reuses what exists, and adds only structure that earns its cost.
state_description: Replies to structure-relevant requests do what the principle asks, and never add machinery that outweighs its benefit.
hints_of_measurement: A judged sample of replies per principle, compared across ways of prompting the AI.

name: Honest Grading
principle: A grade means the reply did what the principle asks, whatever words it used.
state_description: A grader passes replies that do the thing and fails those that only sound like it, and agrees with the human reviewer.
hints_of_measurement: Agreement with reference good and bad replies, and later with the reviewer's own verdicts.

name: Contained Scope
principle: Data stays inside the user, team and quest it belongs to, on every read and write path.
state_description: No retrieval, cache, recall, store or feed returns another scope's content, and what is stored comes back exactly.
hints_of_measurement: Cross-scope probes return nothing; stored items round-trip; fences hold on each backend.

name: Reliable Verdict
principle: A narrow judgment changes a turn only when it is usable.
state_description: A malformed, invented or missing verdict leaves the turn unchanged, and the question is asked with the evidence it depends on.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted bad verdicts are all ignored; good verdicts act; the question carries its evidence.

name: Purposeful Work
principle: Every piece of work names the ideal or gap it serves and is judged by that intent's metric.
state_description: The AI's choice of what to do next reads like the person's own priorities, a gap under an intent is named by its exact text, and finished work leaves its solution's specification better than it found it.
hints_of_measurement: Intent-grounded pass rate; first-pass done rate on tasks that carry a slice; zero extra tokens for a person with no intents.

name: Measured Core ML
principle: Every classification and recommendation Quest depends on has a defined input and output, a held-out labelled case set, and a recorded comparison of its alternatives.
state_description: Anyone can see, for quest classification and for recommendation, which implementation is selected, what it was beaten or tied by, and what it costs per correct answer.
hints_of_measurement: On the same labelled cases, accuracy of each alternative with cost as tie-break; the selected one is the best measured.

name: Specifications that apply are in view
principle: Every run sees the intent specifications that concern its input, and only those, at the cheapest tier that lets it decide.
state_description: The run starts from a handful of one-line specifications with their links, picked from the whole tree in the time of one model call; it reads in full only what it chose, and it is never shown a record that does not exist.
hints_of_measurement: For labelled inputs the expected specifications are in the selection, a failed model or vector call changes nothing but the cost, and the number of model calls is the number of batches.

name: Compounding Context
principle: What one run found is kept as a card that later runs reuse, so every run starts grounded in the person's material at little cost, reads only what is current, and can name where each piece came from.
state_description: A fresh corpus is grounded on its first task with no model call; a repeat task lands on the right sources before any search; the text a run sees is resolved from the current source; every card names its sources and who wrote it.
hints_of_measurement: Model calls and seconds spent assembling context per run, the rank of the right source for a task, stale sources served (none), and cards whose sources and writer are recorded (all).

name: Proportionate Card Store
principle: A store holds one card per distinct topic of its corpus, so its size follows the corpus's distinct content and never grows by re-importing what it already has.
state_description: Running bootstrap again leaves the card count where it was; a topic another store owns is read in place or held once; when a store grows past its expected size the operator is told loudly, and nothing is cut by an arbitrary quota.
hints_of_measurement: Cards per distinct source-file group stays at one and the duplicate share at none after repeated passes, no source-file group is lost by a cleanup, and a store past the notice size produces a notice.

name: One Ranked Context
principle: A run's context comes from one search over everything it may be grounded in, with one ranking and one budget, and every result says what kind of thing it is and where it lives.
state_description: A request that needs a file, a note and the solution it serves gets all three in one assembled view, ranked against each other under one budget, each labelled as a card or as a record of its kind, and each record read from its own file, never from a copy.
hints_of_measurement: On requests whose right answer mixes cards and records the expected items are in view; neither the card selection metric nor the specification selection metric drops; one model call or none per assembly.

name: Checked Improvement per Run
principle: Every run leaves, on the record it served, what it measured, what it moved and what it changed in the record and why, so improvement is checked per run instead of hoped for.
state_description: Opening a solution or a card shows the last run that touched it, its outcome, the metric before and after, what moved, and the last change made to the record with its reason; no reading expires, no record needs a new file to hold it, and a person is asked only when the change needs them.
hints_of_measurement: Share of runs on a measured solution with a durable before and after reading on that solution; share that state what they moved; share of runs that found a record wrong or missing and fixed it in the same change; new files per run (none).

name: Constraining Solutions Identified
principle: Before something is built or changed, every solution that already covers it or constrains it is identified, through a short flat list of tags each of which names the problems it mitigates.
state_description: A change to a model call, a prompt, an outward act or private data brings up the solutions that already guard it, wherever they sit in the records; no tag is on the list without a risk it closes.
hints_of_measurement: On labelled requests, the share where the right solution is missed without the tag; every tag links the problems it mitigates; no tag on every solution.

name: Proportionate Index Scope
principle: The system itself decides, proportionately and without a person, whether a large or high-risk folder is worth looking into: a cheap call per folder, never per file, and it fails closed only where the risk is real.
state_description: Rooting a corpus above a backups folder is harmless: the series of copies is recognised, judged once and kept out, the one real nested project and the ordinary notes are read as before, and a person who wants the copies after all says so in one place and is obeyed.
hints_of_measurement: No card, import or mount comes from a series of copies whether or not a model can be asked; the legitimate nested store and ordinary folders are still taken in; an index verdict from a reviewer or a person is honoured; review calls grow with folders, not files.

name: Continuous Mind
principle: Every step of a request acts with everything the request has established so far: what the person said, refused and corrected, what the request was resolved to mean, and what earlier steps found.
state_description: Working with it feels like working with one person who heard the whole request: a later step never re-proposes what was refused minutes ago, never re-reads what it already has, and never changes the subject.
hints_of_measurement: On multi-step requests where a later step needs something established earlier, every step is consistent with it, at a cost per request no higher than re-sending the context from cache.

hints_of_measurement: Needed items are admitted and near misses are not, on labelled steps; no out-of-scope item is ever admitted.

state_description: A new user asks how to do something and is shown the way; nobody is told the AI cannot do something it can.
hints_of_measurement: Usage questions are recognised and answered correctly from the documentation; claims about what the AI can do in the app are true.

state_description: The AI keeps the person's end in sight, says why a step is the most likely to work for them and how it will be checked, and turns real uncertainty into an experiment they can run.
hints_of_measurement: Recommendations name the metric they serve; uncertain choices lead to an experiment; over time the person's metrics move.

name: Risk Handled Where It Is
principle: Each high-risk case gets the response proven best for its kind of risk, and a low-risk case pays nothing for review.
state_description: Most turns run untouched; when something risky happens, the response that fits that risk (a stronger model, one narrow question, a rule, a hand-off) catches it, and the overall quality of the AI rises.
hints_of_measurement: Per risk category, the chosen response beats no response with statistical significance; the overall evaluation metric is higher with the overseer on than off.
